title: Token-stream stabilization: emergency prefetch safeguard and cross-deploy hotfix
creator: Aisha Thompson
description: Multiple enterprise customers reported sudden regressions in first-token latency and sustained tokens/sec drops starting 2026-03-09 across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private clusters. The regression correlates with a recent kernel selection heuristic change and an eager KV prefetch optimization. This ticket scopes the emergency mitigation, a minimal-risk prefetch safeguard, and follow-ups to stabilize throughput and avoid customer-facing throttles.
impact_summary: Intermittent TTFT regressions (200-800ms added) for short-context requests and degraded sustained tokens/sec for medium-length streams (<512 tokens). Affected customers: Acme Finance (enterprise), LumaDocs (dedicated), and two private VPC deployments. Several customers opened escalations citing SLA threshold breaches and customer-visible slow first responses.
repro_steps: 1) Send 1000 concurrent short-context (prompt ~20 tokens) streaming requests to model-x-variant with default routing.
2) Observe first byte latency distribution; compare against baseline from 2026-03-07.
3) Re-run with KV prefetch enabled vs disabled in runtime config to see delta.
4) Run on dedicated pool with mixed-length workload to reproduce sustained tokens/sec drop.
hypothesis: A change in kernel selection heuristics causes misclassification of sessions with short contexts, triggering aggressive eager KV prefetch. When combined with multiplexed routing under bursty arrivals, prefetch causes head-of-line blocking and kernel preemption, amplifying TTFT and reducing tokens/sec.
mitigation_plan: Hotfix: Introduce a conservative prefetch safeguard toggle (prefetch_threshold_ms) that disables eager prefetch for predicted short-first-token paths. Deploy as feature-flagged config to Hosted first, then Dedicated and Private.
Routing fallback: Temporarily bias smart-router to route short-context, latency-sensitive requests to ‘latency-optimized’ pool where prefetch is off by default.
Rate-limited rollback: If safeguards fail to recover metrics, roll back last kernel-selection heuristic via canary configuration on 5% of traffic.
Customer comms: Notify affected customers with mitigations and ETA; offer dedicated capacity burst while fix rolls out.
acceptance_criteria: Median TTFT for short-context streaming requests returns to within 10% of baseline (2026-03-07) in Hosted after safeguard rollout.
Sustained tokens/sec across representative medium-length stream workload recovers to baseline within 30 minutes of mitigation.
No increase in error rate or token-level cost above 5% post-mitigation.
Affected customers confirm observed improvement or accept temporary mitigation within SLA window.
follow_ups: Postmortem doc linking telemetry traces, root-cause analysis, and long-term kernel-selection guardrails (owner: Marco Ruiz).
Automated regression test in CI to simulate prefetch+kernel heuristic interaction under multiplexed loads (owner: Priya Patel).
Consolidate prefetch tuning into Optimize recommendations and add a UI toggle in Console for tenant-level prefetch policy (owner: Design/PM).
